# Typed quality validation v1

Immutable provider artifact containing the owning repository's 22-file typed
quality correction set over source checkpoint
`d58fc8428cd359860b4feaacb3cf90387c0d2f8e`.
SHA-256: `3272076745c91d1c3067c3f9f45d3c40e1b4e17a51ef62738e44446ab81b75f0`.

The corrections make boundary values, callable checks, nullish values and void
callbacks explicit across the Claude, Codex and OpenCode adapters and attachment
validation. Existing capture-gap guards, deadlines and budgets remain enforced.
The Claude idle notification fix and OpenCode snapshot-shape validation remain
part of this successor.

The archive contains 209 regular files, including 206 dist files. Session SPI is
unchanged. Native/Desktop qualification is separate; previous archives and
evidence remain immutable.
